summary: Vernal Capital Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its initial public offering (IPO) of 10,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for $100M gross proceeds, and a simultaneous private placement of 251,250 units to sponsors at the same price. Net proceeds of $100.5M were deposited into a trust account. This is a standard blank-check company IPO closing disclosure—not a special situation such as a business combination, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing simply discloses the IPO consummation and related trust deposit.
